title: Is that all? / I don't have any ..., but I have some ...
subtitle: 就这些吗？/ 我没有……，可我有……

lead.question: 你在文具店要买信封、信纸、墨水、胶水、一大盒粉笔，最后说「就这些吗」——怎样用 some/any 一样一样报出要买的东西，又怎样用 one 指代「一盒/一本」？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象你在文具店：要大号还是小号信封？要信纸（注意 writing paper 不可数，不能说 a writing paper）、要墨水、要胶水、要一大盒粉笔。售货员说只有小盒的粉笔，问「你要一盒吗」——这里的 one 代替 one small box of chalk。听录音时留意 some/any 在肯定、疑问、否定里的分工，以及 one 怎么代替刚提过的单数可数名词。
goals: 能用 Do you want the large size or the small size? 选择尺码
理解 writing paper, glue, chalk, ink 是不可数，需借量词 a pad / a bottle of / a box of
能用 Do you have any ...? / I don't have any ... 表示有无
理解 one 代替前文单数可数名词（one small box of chalk）
会用 Is that all? / What else do you want? 收尾购物对话
lead.summary: 第 59 课女士在文具店买信封、信纸簿、墨水、胶水和粉笔，售货员只有小盒粉笔，问 Do you want one?；女士说「就这些」并要找零。全课集中操练 some/any 与 one 的用法。第 60 课用 I don't have any X, but I have some Y. 反复替换水果、蔬菜、食品，巩固 any（否定/疑问）与 some（肯定）的对立。
lead.tips: ① writing paper / glue / chalk / ink 不可数，不能说 a writing paper，要 a piece of paper / a bottle of ink / a box of chalk；② some 用于肯定，any 用于否定和疑问；③ Do you want one? 中 one 代替 one small box of chalk，避免重复；④ I only have small boxes 后省了 of chalk；⑤ Is that all? 是店员收尾问句，That's all. 是顾客答「就这些」；⑥ change 指零钱。

questions.q: Does the lady buy any chalk?
questions.zh: 这位女士有没有买粉笔？
questions.a: No, she doesn't. The shop assistant only has small boxes and she doesn't want one.
questions.aZh: 没有。售货员只有小盒的，她不要。
questions.hint: 听 And I want a large box of chalk... I only have small boxes. Do you want one? / No, thank you.

questions.q: What size envelopes does the lady want?

questions.hint: Do you want the large size, or the small size? — The large size please.

questions.q: What does the lady want besides envelopes and writing paper?
questions.zh: 除了信封和信纸，女士还想要什么？
questions.a: Some black ink, some glue, and a large box of chalk.
questions.aZh: 黑色墨水、胶水和一大盒粉笔。
questions.hint: And I want some black ink and some glue. / And I want a large box of chalk, too.

questions.q: What does 'Do you want one?' refer to?
questions.zh: 「Do you want one?」里的 one 指什么？
questions.hint: 前文 I only have small boxes. boxes 后是 of chalk 的省略。

questions.q: Why can't we say 'a writing paper' or 'a chalk'?
questions.zh: 为什么不能说 a writing paper、a chalk 这种带 a 的说法？
questions.a: paper, glue, chalk, ink are uncountable nouns in English; they take no a/an and no plural. To count them you use measure phrases: a piece of paper, a bottle of ink, a box of chalk.
questions.aZh: paper/glue/chalk/ink 在英语里不可数，不加 a/an、无复数；要计数得用量词短语。
questions.hint: 不可数名词靠量词短语来计数。

questions.q: I don't have any grapes, but I have some peaches. / I don't have any mince, but I have some steak.
questions.zh: 第 60 课操练：把瓜果食品成对填进 I don't have any ___ , but I have some ___.
questions.a: I don't have any tomatoes, but I have some potatoes.
questions.aZh: 我没有西红柿，可我有土豆。
questions.hint: 否定用 any，肯定用 some。

grammar.title: some 与 any 的用法
grammar.structure: some（肯定句）/ any（否定句、疑问句）
grammar.definition: some 和 any 都表示「一些」，后接可数复数或不可数名词。some 用于肯定句；any 用于否定句和疑问句。
grammar.usage: I want some envelopes. / I don't have any small pads. / Do you have any writing paper?

examples.en: I want some black ink and some glue.
examples.zh: 我想要一些黑色墨水和胶水。

examples.en: I don't have any small pads.

grammar.title: 代词 one 代替单数可数名词
grammar.structure: one（单数可数）/ ones（复数可数）代替前文名词
grammar.definition: one 是代词，代替刚提过的单数可数名词，避免重复。前文有 a pad / a box of chalk，售货员问 Do you want one? 中 one = one small box of chalk。复数用 ones。
grammar.usage: I only have large ones. / Do you want one?

examples.en: Do you want a pad? — Yes, please.
examples.zh: 您要一本吗？——好，请拿一本。

examples.en: I only have small boxes. Do you want one?
examples.zh: 我只有小盒的。您要一盒吗？

grammar.title: 不可数名词与量词短语
grammar.structure: a piece of / a bottle of / a box of / a pad of + 不可数名词
grammar.definition: writing paper, glue, chalk, ink 等不可数，不能加 a/an、无复数。要表示数量须借助可数量词短语；量词本身可数。
grammar.usage: a piece of paper, a bottle of ink, a box of chalk, a pad of writing paper

examples.en: A bottle of ink and a bottle of glue.
I want a large box of chalk, too.
